evidence.scope: Make the harness enforce what it currently only records: a RED that did not fail is refused, a tdd stage without a red and a green per slice or with coverage going backwards cannot advance, and a delivery whose checks are not green on the delivered commit is refused.
acceptance: harness check --phase red on a passing command is refused with a message saying the RED did not fail: evidenced by the test and by a recorded attempt
advance from tdd is refused without a red and a green per slice, and with a negative coverage delta on packages/core, naming what is missing: evidenced by tests for each refusal

ci.yml runs typecheck, tests with coverage, build, gitleaks, pnpm audit at high, graphify extract and the harness tests, and a seeded secret on a throwaway branch fails the pipeline: evidenced by a green run and by the deliberately failed one
The pull request template is applied automatically and verify-delivery refuses a pull request body without the receipt hash: evidenced by the template file and the refusal test
harness return appends a rework record and status shows the ticket back at the target stage: already delivered by SEEN-086 and re-verified here by a test
Carried in: verify-delivery refuses while a check on the delivered commit is not green, and refuses a receipt whose commit is behind the branch tip: evidenced by tests against a stubbed checks reader
decisions: AC3 is amended rather than deferred: migrations applied twice need the database SEEN-007 and SEEN-008 deliver, so that half is re-pointed to SEEN-008 which can prove idempotence against a real schema. Founder, 23 September 2026

Coverage is measured by vitest with the v8 provider on packages/core only, and the last delivered figure is kept in docs/harness/coverage.json so a delta has something to compare against. Coverage for the other packages is reported and not gated, because a gate on a package with placeholder tests measures nothing

The CI green check reads the GitHub checks API through gh when it is available, and refuses the delivery when gh is missing or unauthenticated rather than passing silently: a delivery that cannot be verified is not a delivery verified
A RED is judged by its exit code and its phase: zero is not a RED, and neither is a timeout or a command that could not start, because neither says anything about the behaviour under test
The refusal message defect from SEEN-006 is fixed here rather than in SEEN-090: it is gate enforcement, which is this ticket's subject
graph_impact: harness/checks.py records the phases; the RED rule belongs beside the recording
harness/gates.py holds the tdd relations that the coverage and evidence rules extend
harness/delivery.py is where the CI and receipt-versus-tip checks attach
